name: User Ratings 1.0.2.0, the Data tab: in the default sandbox as admin, with viewer in their own window, the desktop layout: the settings page's Data tab read with GETs only (and the page's own Detached/Seen), no select; before a file Dry run and Import are off; Export runs as a job (POST 202, polled), its file fetched with the session's authorization (no token in any query) and handed to a blob: download link, which the run keeps in the page (a[download] clicks prevented, so no file is written): the kit's export envelope of User Ratings 1.0.2.0 with the users' ids in the "N" format, every table and viewer's row; Download again gives the same name and bytes; that file in the file field: Import stays off until a Merge dry run by id (the file sent as it is, every row Unchanged, the report as text); viewer changes their review: Import asks first, then the job's 409 Changed shows in the tab's words, nothing is imported and Import is off again; the dry run again (viewer's row kept as newer here) and Import: the report names the import's snapshot, listed as "Before an import"; viewer changes their review again; Restore… of the import's snapshot asks first (Cancel focused), then restores it: viewer's review as before the import, the restore's own snapshot named and listed. Then viewer rates Tagged Movie (its folder's TMDb id) 4.5 stars with a review, and Export for Jellyfin Enhanced fetches JE 12.14's reviews.json with one GET (its only query leaveOutRestricted=true, the default choice since 0.3.24) and saves it the same way: only Reviews, its keys sorted, each <userIdN>:<movie|tv>:<tmdbKey> with JE's seven fields in order, TmdbId the whole key; viewer's Tagged Movie in it with 4.5 and the text as it is; Long Test Movie counted as no TMDb id when the film has none; the status counting the reviews. Every rating on Long Test Movie and Tagged Movie removed at the end.
